_help.audio_mode: What to do with a swear in the audio: 'mute' (silence), 'close_gap' (cut the word out and close the gap), or 'splice' (swap in a clean word the same actor says elsewhere in the game - experimental).
_help.splice_fallback: In splice mode, what to do when no good matching word is found: 'close_gap' or 'mute'.
_help.splice_min_match: How closely the stand-in word's voice must match (0-1). Higher = stricter, fewer splices.
_help.splice_options: For each swear, real words that can stand in for it. Only words the actors actually say in the game can be used.
_help.captions: true = also clean the subtitles to match. false = voice lines only.
_help.test_mode: true = subtitles show every removed word in *asterisks* where it was cut, so you can check what the mod changed. The audio is cleaned as normal. Set back to false and run INSTALL.bat again for normal play.
